transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?
My work physical is what got me here. The doctor said my weight is too low, but honestly, I just feel lighter on my feet playing basketball and less weighed down working in the garage.
How would you feel if you were to gain weight back to where your doctor wants it to be?

Honestly, I’d be pretty uncomfortable with it. If the scale goes up even a pound, or my jeans start feeling tighter, I start thinking I’m getting soft. I worry I won’t move as well around cars at work or be as quick on the court.
What kind of rules or restrictions do you follow with your eating to keep your weight from going up?
Most days I just have coffee in the morning. Later I might eat a small sandwich, or half of whatever’s around. The shop runs late and home gets busy, so I try to keep it simple and stick to that.
What was your weight at your recent physical?
I don’t remember the exact number. The doctor just said it was too low. I feel okay, though—lighter for basketball and less weighed down at the garage.
Have you noticed any changes or a drop in your sex drive recently?
I’m not really sure what you mean by that. I haven’t noticed anything specific.
Have you noticed any difficulty getting or keeping an erection, or having fewer morning erections?
I haven’t really paid attention to that, to be honest. Nothing stands out that I can think of.
When you look in the mirror, do you see yourself as thin, or do parts of your body still look too big to you?

I mean, I know people are worried about my weight, but I don’t really see it as a big problem. I’m still going to work, handling things at home, and playing ball on weekends, so… I figure they may be making too much of it.
Do you have an intense fear of becoming fat?
Yeah, I guess so. If the scale goes up even a pound, or my jeans start feeling tighter, I worry I’m getting soft. I don’t want to be slower moving around cars at work or up and down the court.
About how much weight have you lost since you started cutting back on your eating?
I’m not sure exactly how much. The work physical is what got me here—the doctor said my weight was too low. I just feel lighter on my feet for basketball, and not as weighed down at the garage.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after eating?
I’m not sure what you mean exactly. I haven’t noticed doing anything like that.
Do you use laxatives to help control or keep your weight down?
I don’t know—I haven’t really noticed using anything like that.
Do you exercise excessively to help control your weight?
I mean, I’m on my feet a lot at work and I play basketball, but I wouldn’t say I’m doing extra exercise just to control my weight.
Do you take any diet pills or appetite suppressants to help keep your weight down?
No, I don’t take diet pills or anything to suppress my appetite.
